title: Normal finite-index inverse images of finite normal fixing groups
statement: Let G be a group, Ω = AlgebraicClosure ℚ, r : G → Autℚ(Ω) a homomorphism, and E an intermediate field of Ω/ℚ. If E is finite-dimensional and normal over ℚ, then K = r⁻¹(Fix(E)) is a normal finite-index subgroup of G.
lean_statement: ∀ {G : Type} [Group G] (r : G →* (AlgebraicClosure ℚ ≃ₐ[ℚ] AlgebraicClosure ℚ)) (E : IntermediateField ℚ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ)), FiniteDimensional ℚ E → Normal ℚ E → (E.fixingSubgroup.comap r).Normal ∧ (E.fixingSubgroup.comap r).FiniteIndex
